statement: For each h ≥ 0, the connected marking through exponent ph has a finite free model Hm,h over Am. There are coordinates a0, . . . , ah and polynomials in earlier coordinates such that apm−1 0 = x, apm i − xpi ai = Pi(a0, . . . , ai−1), 1 ≤ i ≤ h. (3.3) If the first Hasse coefficient is normalized only up to a unit, the corresponding unit factors are inserted in these equations. The residue monomials ae0 0 ae1 1 · · · aeh h , 0 ≤ e0 < pm − 1, 0 ≤ ei < pm (i > 0), 16 are an Am-basis. The G-action preserves this model and admits a finite filtration with quotients integer powers of Lm. The filtration remains such a filtration on every deeper height locus.
